name: Samples: the Model:Samples' filter on every track, lowpass below the centre of Cutoff, highpass above
description: The first real filter of model27's filter slot (the track filters, notes/72): SAMPLE's filter, the Model:Samples' laws measured and rebuilt in Cycles One-Shot, on any track whose sound chose it (RETRIG + PITCH), after Volume + Dist. RETRIG + SWEEP is Cutoff: a lowpass below the centre, a highpass above, nothing at the centre; RETRIG + CONTOUR is Reso. Both are real parameters of every machine: p-locks, LFO, velocity, CC 74 and 71. The sources are SAMPLE's (tools/machines/sampler/src/), unchanged. Since 0.2 two savings for six tracks: the coefficients are looked up only when Cutoff or Reso has moved (bit for bit the same), and a silent track is skipped once the filter has rung out below -102 dB. Since 0.3 Cutoff's short name, which the LFO's destination shows, is CUTO (FREQ before). Since 0.4 two more, bit for bit the same: a block is looked at for silence only once the filter has rung out (its first and last frames first), and the centre returns before that.

uses.name: Samples
uses.why: a filter of the filter slot: called after Volume + Dist as (block, k 28 to k 31, track, triggered) on the tracks whose sound chose id 1

emulation.pattern: instructions per track and block, Samples' own code only (smpf_process, smp_filter_set, smp_filter_run, the frame loop), on the OS 1.13 in tools/emu/test_fltslot.py's filter_cost (mcengine.py's counter): all six tracks on it, the stock machines playing, a state held for 8 blocks after 8 of warm-up (lowpass Cutoff 32, highpass 96, centre 64, glide: Cutoff 48 / 88 and Reso every block; silent: no note played, the filter set and rung out), the maximum, and the block in which the tracks come to it from none (its reset and first block); the filter slot's own instructions apart

unchanged: every track whose sound has not chosen Samples

emulation.tool: tools/emu/test_fltslot.py (Unicorn, the OS's own code; against the host build of the same sources)
